fields.label: Add-ons
fields.options:
Fluid is this site's custom app for ERPNext add-ons. Everything below ships with the app and is updated on bench migrate; change it in the repository, not on screen.

Add-onTypeOpen
Fluid ERP: keyboard-first entry, day book, reportsApp page/fluid
Business dashboard: production, sales, purchases, weighmentsWeb Page/dashboard
Daily review: flip cardsWeb Page/daily
Daily review: storiesWeb Page/stories
Daily Operations Review: 3-page landscape PDFPrint Format on DRI ProductionDaily Operations Review
Kiln DPR, one kiln per A3 sheetPrint Format on DRI ProductionKiln DPR A3
Daily PDF to Telegram at 10:00 (settings below)Server Script, scheduledDaily Operations Review Sender
Send a file to Telegram by URLServer Script, APIsendtelegramfile

Targets and other figures (15,000 MT a month, 14 MW, FG-0001, ₹50,000 minimum) are set at the top of each page's script or print format. Details for each add-on are in docs/erpnext/ in the repository.

fields.label: Pause the daily PDF
fields.description: Stops the 10:00 send without touching the server script.

fields.label: Telegram Settings profile
fields.description: The Telegram Settings record the PDF goes to. Left empty: NPSL Purchase.

fields.label: File-sending API method
fields.description: API method of the server script that sends a file to Telegram. Left empty: sendtelegramfile.
